scope: Pinned V-DPM environment and checkpoint preflight for the real flower clip
summary: Official V-DPM source and a CUDA-compatible smoke environment are ready, but real inference is blocked because the 6.65 GB public checkpoint cannot be reached or found in authorized caches.
evidence: Official source is pinned at commit 5e2a57cf6007dfb0511a8b396a0805089b9edcc4 and VGGT at 44b3afbd1869d8bde4894dd8ea1e293112dd5eba.
A virtualenv reusing torch 2.6.0+cu124 and torchvision 0.21.0+cu124 imports VDPM and executes a finite CUDA tensor smoke on physical A800 GPU 1.
Two failed uv environments are retained as negative evidence: dependency resolution installed Torch 2.13/CUDA13 and caused a torchvision ABI mismatch.
The upstream exact Torch 2.5.1 wheel download did not complete and was stopped; this compatibility environment is not claimed as the matched baseline.
HF CLI, official Hugging Face range GET and hf-mirror range GET all fail or time out, and no authorized host cache contains model.pt.
lessons: Dependency resolvers must not silently upgrade the core CUDA framework for a pinned model.
A successful code/CUDA import is not model evidence without the exact checkpoint.
limitations: No V-DPM model inference or point-map artifact exists.
The current smoke environment differs from upstream Torch 2.5.1.
next_actions: Obtain model.pt through an authorized reachable mirror or pre-populated cache, verify its hash, then run one-window inference before the full clip.
